baselineDisplay.title: Hurry Up
baselineDisplay.question: How do you know Sam doesn't make the tea very often?
baselineDisplay.questionZh: 你怎么知道山姆不经常泡茶的？
baselineDisplay.text:
How do you know Sam doesn't make the tea very often?

Can you make the tea, Sam?
Yes, of course I can, Penny.
Is there any water in this kettle?
Yes, there is.
Where's the tea?
It's over there, behind the teapot.
Can you see it?
I can see the teapot, but I can't see the tea.
There it is!
It's in front of you!
Ah yes, I can see it now.
Where are the cups?
There are some in the cupboard.
Can you find them?
Yes. Here they are.
Hurry up, Sam!
The kettle's boiling!

baselineDisplay.bodyTextZh:
你能泡茶吗，山姆？
当然能，佩妮。
这个水壶里有水吗？
有。
茶在哪里？
就在那儿，茶壶后面。
你能看到它吗？
我能看到茶壶，但看不到茶。
在那儿呢！
它就在你面前！
啊，对，我现在看到了。
杯子在哪里？
橱柜里有几个。
你能找到它们吗？
能。在这儿呢。
快点，萨姆！
水壶已经烧开了！

notes: 通读17句泡茶对话与提问；核对kettle/teapot/tea/cups位置及烧水末句，Sam反复找物与问题关联完整。中文山姆/萨姆为同名音译保留来源，can/cannot含义对应；只规范课号间距。
